about: Hey, I'm Raihan! I'm currently a Software Developer Intern at Rocket Innovation Studio…

posts.text: We built FIFA, but with hotels, and won at Hack the 6ix?! 🏆⚽🏨 Inspired by the World Cup, our team decided to take on the Stay22: Peak Unhinged Big Brain Use of the Stay22 API challenge and ended up winning the track. We built Check-In Champions, a gamified hotel discovery platform that transforms real hotel listings powered by Stay22 into collectible football player cards. I'm excited to share that I'll be joining Rocket this fall as a Software Developer Intern with Rocket Innovation Studio 🚀🚀 Thank you to the Rocket hiring team for a smooth recruiting process. Looking forward to learning, building, and contributing alongside the team 👨‍💻

Access to essential services for those in need should be simple, reliable, and immediate. That’s why we built Beacon at GenAI Genesis 2026 🧠 Beacon is an app designed to help people quickly find essential services based on their location while also supporting longer-term planning to help them move beyond their current challenges. Had a great weekend @ HackHive 2026 with Tony Park, Suhiyini Kasim, and Aarnav Shrivastava, where we built Ez Form, an AI voice-enabled PDF form filler focused on accessibility. Ez Form lets users complete PDF forms through natural conversation instead of typing, helping reduce barriers created by keyboards, dense paperwork, and complex interfaces, especially for older adults and anyone who struggles with traditional digital forms.
